title: Concrete Roots
summary: This song channels the intensity and aggression of heavy rock and metal, rooted in a gritty, real-world story of a father's last stand against city decay. The raw energy and driving rhythms mirror Soundgarden’s dark edge and AC/DC’s urgency, while Metallica’s momentum is preserved in the structure and dread. Uncertainty in specific vocal phrasing, but the tone aligns with the listed genres.

cases.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Steel beams creak under his grip.
Fingers bleed, but he won’t quit.
Concrete cracks like a dying breath.
He’s the last man standing.

[Chorus]
Fist in the air, no time to hide.
Fist in the air, no time to die.
Fist in the air, no time to die.
Fist in the air, no time to die.

[Verse 2]
He rips the wire, sparks in the wind.
Cars screech, the city denies.
One hand on the door, one on the ground.
Still stands, still stands, still stands.

[Chorus]
Fist in the air, no time to hide.
Fist in the air, no time to die.
Fist in the air, no time to die.
Fist in the air, no time to die.

[Bridge]
No witness, no name.
Just steel and smoke.
Just steel and smoke.
Just steel and smoke.

[Chorus]
Fist in the air, no time to hide.
Fist in the air, no time to die.
Fist in the air, no time to die.
Fist in the air, no time to die.

[Outro]
Fist in the air.
Fist in the air.
Fist in the air.
